items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And you did 'Someone Else Will Take Your Place,' Ramping Brown... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, uh-huh. Yeah, who was that with there?

ctx.x: It was next to Downhearted,' made a lot of money, because I had those old bogus contracts on it, you see. I had those bad contracts.
And you did 'Someone Else Will Take Your Place,' Ramping Brown, and 'You Can Have My Man If He Comes To See You Too.'
Yeah, uh-huh. Yeah, who was that with there?
